action.prompt: This repo has an AGENTS.md at the workspace root that is a living memory file of gotchas, setup steps, and conventions. Read it early in the session. IMPORTANT: whenever during this session you diagnose a non-obvious failure, discover an undocumented setup step, or learn anything a future agent would waste time re-learning, proactively append it to AGENTS.md (symptom → cause → fix, numbered sequentially) and, if user-facing, mirror it into the README Troubleshooting section. Do this automatically without being asked.
